newsitem.title: USA: Evicted single mother wins New York lottery jackpot.
newsitem.headline: Evicted single mother wins New York lottery jackpot.

text.p: A single mother of two children won the $4 million LOTTO jackpot just one day after being evicted from her Brooklyn home.
"Does anyone want to marry me?" winner Princess Caesar jokingly asked reporters on Thursday as she left a New York Lottery Games news conference at which her windfall was announced.
Caesar, whose age was not disclosed, was the sole winner of the Jan. 11 jackpot. She said she planned to take a vacation but otherwise did not expect her life to change.

"My daughter came home from school Friday to find out we had been evicted," she said. "Sunday, she read the paper and saw that all six of my numbers had been drawn...now, I can pay for her to go to college."
